ability_extra.cpu_fallback_note: none observed; last_cpu_fallback empty means no fallback
ability_extra.debug_overlay_semantics: NoteDebugRepaint draws only on live color/picture paints; clean RepaintBoundary Replay bypasses it
ability_extra.frame_raster_note: gate frame_raster_ms includes the final SnapshotPath GPU readback/PNG; live_frame_raster_ms is the last live tick and is the steady-frame figure
ability_extra.g_metrics_reason: R12b is a debug-overlay correctness window; measure cache fields are observed but not gated
ability_extra.impl_cache: static blocks/panels are RepaintBoundaries: first live paint records, later frames Replay (boundary_skip) with no overlay; their pixels stay raw. hotA/hotB are clean boundary controls in gate.
ability_extra.impl_correctness: overlay is drawn by PaintContext.NoteDebugRepaint inside the live color-box path; clean boundary Replay returns before the overlay. Gate live leaf is a plain leaf painted every FullPaint frame, so on=blend/off=raw is deterministic; hotA/hotB/static boundaries stay raw.
ability_extra.impl_dirty: gate: frozen Steady, no boundary dirt (static/hotA/hotB clean); gate live leaf is non-boundary and FullPaint repaints it every frame. manual: Steady hotA changes every tick; Spike hotA+hotB change every tick; Recover stops dirty marks after the last Spike frame.
ability_extra.impl_edge: on/off separate gate runs and separate Golden baselines; 36 static color boxes, 20+ static labels, 4x4 grid, cached strips/footer, clean hotA/hotB controls, gate-only live leaf; FullPaint pinned; manual Steady->Spike->Recover.
ability_extra.impl_fail: on debug_draws=0 or off debug_draws>0; live leaf pixel not blend/raw; hot/static pixel shows overlay; golden diff!=0 or mask px mismatch; logic fail; policy!=full_paint; fps<55 or p95>22 -> FAIL
ability_extra.impl_visible: on: live leaf magenta blend, hotA orange/hotB green/static raw; off: live leaf raw red and no overlay anywhere; HUD shows debug state, flash draws, skip/rr and phase; manual cycles Steady/Spike/Recover.
ability_extra.rss_slope_note: rss_slope_valid=false: an 8s gate/15s manual run is shorter than the >=30s steady-slope verdict; raw slope is startup-inclusive and is not a leak conclusion
ability_extra.rss_slope_steady_note: steady slope is omitted while valid=false (short run); omission means 'cannot conclude', not 'no leak' (TestBuildReport_ShortRunSlopeInvalidIsHonest)
ability_extra.snapshot_note: gate snapshot (GPU readback); SnapshotPath now carries the R12b debug flag, so the overlay is in the evidence PNG
